notes.C01: One cheap signal drives demotion, caption skip and tags, cutting image tokens on speech-heavy video; risk is layout-blind embeddings.
notes.C02: Deletes the metered VLM with a fire-rate kill criterion, but depends on retrieval quality being good enough.
notes.C03: Cluster sheets with a return map reduce repeat tokens, but a layout switch adds a recurrence knob.
notes.C04: Removes heuristics, but uniform sampling raises embed cost and the codec signals are partly kept anyway; unproven.
notes.C05: Ask-conditioned sheets with a coverage floor are directly useful to the harness, though close to proposed find.
notes.C06: Text-only default is a bold token cut, but vague on how the redundant/adds tag is computed and it depends on C01.
notes.C07: Check loop on the agent's summary is a fresh way to close the analysis loop and gives a label-free score; claim-to-frame matching is noisy.
notes.C08: Three-tower agreement needs the audio tower always loaded and adds cost for marginal chapter gain.
notes.C09: Replaces hand-set knobs with per-video calibration; real maintenance win, but Otsu on few cuts is fragile.
notes.C10: Admission-gated audio tag is disciplined but the payoff is narrow (silent windows only).
notes.C11: Paired tokens-per-correct-answer ledger against a random arm is the proof mechanism every other idea needs; high leverage and cheap.
notes.C12: Audit sheet and gap trace add honesty to the output, cheap, but a modest effect on understanding.
notes.C13: Documentation of deletions is process, not an embedding use; low value.
notes.C14: Cheap recall sweep to pick MRL dims, with a clear first move, but small and expected.
notes.C15: Scope-checking meta idea adds no use of the model; low value.
